verdict.rationale: Temporal ships a first-party Schedules feature that starts Workflow Executions at specific times, which it describes as more flexible than its Cron Jobs; Cron Jobs are also listed as a workflow feature. Together these directly cover recurring scheduled workflows rather than one-off starts. missing for 10: documented detail on recurrence specs (intervals/calendar expressions), schedule management such as pause/backfill/overlap policies, and independent hands-on corroboration of recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: A Schedule contains instructions for starting a Workflow Execution at specific times.
Schedules provide a more flexible and user-friendly approach than Temporal Cron Jobs.
